title: The Majesty of God
definition: The majesty of God is His supreme greatness, royal splendor, and exalted authority over all creation.
summary: God is infinitely greater than all He has made. His majesty calls for reverence, humility, awe, worship, and trust. He is not small, weak, limited, or ordinary.
christFocus: Jesus reveals divine majesty through His authority over creation, demons, sickness, sin, death, and judgment. The Lamb who was slain is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's majesty means He is exalted above all. No ruler, nation, power, fear, suffering, or spiritual enemy compares with Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Small thoughts of God produce fearful, shallow, and man-centered living. Seeing God's majesty helps believers worship reverently and trust Him deeply.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Lift your eyes from your circumstances to the greatness of God. Worship Him with reverence, speak of Him with honor, and trust that He reigns above all things.
